UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's public profile information.

fullName_lowercase.description: The user's full name, lowercased for searching.

name_tokens.description: An array of lowercased words from the first and last name for searching.

photoURL.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

location.description: The user's location. The city, state, and country are public, while latitude and longitude are private and used for geosensitive features.

city_lowercase.description: Lowercase city for searching and aggregation.

state_lowercase.description: Lowercase state for searching and aggregation.

country_lowercase.description: Lowercase country for searching and aggregation.

latitude.description: The user's private latitude for proximity calculations.

longitude.description: The user's private longitude for proximity calculations.

dailyDiscipline.description: Tracks the user's completed daily disciplines for the current day.

readingHistory.description: A log of the user's Bible reading sessions.

prayerLinks.description: A list of personal prayer links.

newCampaignsInArea.description: Notify user about new campaigns in their area.

weeklyDigest.description: Send a weekly summary of activity.

accountabilityPartners.description: A list of the user's accountability partners.

userId.description: The UID of the accountability partner.

firstName.description: The first name of the accountability partner.

lastName.description: The last name of the accountability partner.

photoURL.description: The photo URL of the accountability partner.

partnerIds.description: An array of partner UIDs for efficient security rule checks.

lastChurchAttended.description: The name of the last church the user attended.

name.description: The name of the user's church.

branch.description: The specific branch of the church, if applicable.

location.description: The city or area of the church.

schedule.description: The user's worship schedule, with each item containing a day and time.

url.description: The URL for the live stream of the service.

attendanceHistory.description: A log of the user's church attendance.

branch.description: The specific branch of the church, if applicable.

location.description: The city or area of the church.

reason.description: The reason or notes for attending the service.

monthlySoulsGoal.description: The user's personal goal for souls won for the current month.

lastActive.description: Timestamp of the user's last activity.

DailyDisciplineLog.title: Daily Discipline Log
DailyDisciplineLog.description: A record of completed disciplines for a given day. The document ID is the date string 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

Testimony.title: Testimony
Testimony.description: A user's testimony of what God has done.

imageUrl.description: An optional image URL associated with the testimony.

campaignId.description: The ID of the campaign this testimony is related to, if any.

campaignTitle.description: The title of the campaign this testimony is related to, if any.

authorLocation.description: The location of the testimony author.

supporters.description: A list of UIDs of users who have supported this testimony.

answeredPrayerId.description: The ID of the prayer request this testimony is an answer to.

answeredPrayerContent.description: The original content of the prayer that was answered.

PrayerRequest.title: Prayer Request
PrayerRequest.description: A user's prayer request, shared with the community.

usersWhoPrayed.description: A list of UIDs of users who have prayed for this request.

isAnonymous.description: If true, the author's identity is hidden.

status.description: The status of the prayer request.

answeredTestimonyId.description: The ID of the testimony that answers this prayer request.

location.description: The campaign's address or general location, often autofilled by Google Maps.

latitude.description: The latitude of the campaign's pinned location.

longitude.description: The longitude of the campaign's pinned location.

coverageRadius.description: The radius of the campaign's coverage area in meters.

maxParticipants.description: The maximum number of participants allowed in the campaign.

status.description: The current status of the campaign.

lastUpdateReason.description: The reason for the last update.

deletionReason.description: The reason for deleting the campaign.

deletedAt.description: Timestamp when the campaign was deleted.

scripture.description: An inspirational scripture for the campaign.

scriptureTestimony.description: The organizer's personal testimony or caption related to the scripture.

soulsLogged.description: The total number of souls logged for this campaign.

streamUrl.description: A URL to a live stream for the campaign (e.g., YouTube Live, Zoom).

Soul.title: Soul
Soul.description: Represents a person led to Christ, tracked by a user.

church.description: The church the soul is attending.

campaignId.description: The ID of the campaign this soul was won through.

userLocation.description: The location of the user who won the soul.

locationWon.description: The location where the soul was won.

followUpLog.description: A log of follow-up interactions with the soul.

inServiceDepartment.description: Indicates if the soul is serving in a department in church.

fellowshipId.description: The ID of the fellowship group the soul is a part of.

fellowshipName.description: The name of the fellowship group, denormalized for display.

CampaignParticipant.title: Campaign Participant
CampaignParticipant.description: Represents a user who has joined a campaign.

joinReason.description: The user's reason for joining the campaign.

JoinedCampaign.title: Joined Campaign
JoinedCampaign.description: A record indicating that a user has joined a specific campaign.

Chat.title: Chat
Chat.description: A chat session, which can be a group chat for a campaign, a private one-on-one chat related to a campaign, or a private chat between accountability partners.

campaignId.description: The ID of the campaign this chat is related to, if applicable.

campaignTitle.description: The title of the campaign this chat is related to, if applicable.

isGroupChat.description: Indicates if this is a group chat. If false, it's a one-on-one chat.

ChatMessage.title: Chat Message
ChatMessage.description: A single message within a chat session.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Represents an in-app notification for a user.

userId.description: The ID of the user who should receive the notification.

link.description: A URL link to the relevant page (e.g., campaign or chat).

AccountabilityRequest.title: Accountability Request
AccountabilityRequest.description: A request from one user to another to become accountability partners.

participantIds.description: A sorted array of the two participants' UIDs.

Mail.title: Mail
Mail.description: An email to be sent by the Trigger Email extension.

to.description: A list of email addresses to send the email to.

BibleHighlight.title: Bible Highlight
BibleHighlight.description: Represents a user's highlight and notes on Bible verses.

note.description: The user's personal note on the highlight.

Fellowship.title: Fellowship
Fellowship.description: A small group of believers who meet regularly for prayer, study, and mutual support.

name.description: The name of the fellowship group.

description.description: A short description of the fellowship's purpose and goals.

memberIds.description: An array of member UIDs for efficient security rule checks.

memberCount.description: The total number of members in the fellowship.

location.description: Where the fellowship meets (e.g., 'Online via Zoom', '123 Main St, Anytown').

streamUrl.description: A URL to a live stream for the fellowship (e.g., YouTube Live, Zoom).

FellowshipMember.title: Fellowship Member
FellowshipMember.description: Represents a user who has joined a fellowship.

JoinedFellowship.title: Joined Fellowship
JoinedFellowship.description: A record indicating that a user has joined a specific fellowship.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores public user profile data, keyed by user ID.

/users/{userId}/joinedCampaigns/{campaig.description: Stores a reference to campaigns a user has joined.

/users/{userId}/disciplineHistory/{logId.description: Stores a user's daily discipline completion history.

/users/{userId}/bibleHighlights/{highlig.description: Stores a user's Bible highlights and notes.

/souls/{soulId}.description: A global collection of all souls won, for aggregation purposes.

/users/{userId}/souls/{soulId}.description: Stores souls won by a specific user.

/users/{userId}/notifications/{notificat.description: Stores notifications for a specific user.

/prayerRequests/{requestId}.description: Stores user-submitted prayer requests, intended to be anonymous.

/campaigns/{campaignId}/participants/{us.description: Stores participants of a specific campaign, allowing the organizer to see who has joined.

/chats/{chatId}.description: Stores private chat sessions between a user and campaign organizer.

/chats/{chatId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Stores messages for a specific chat session.

/accountabilityRequests/{requestId}.description: Stores accountability partnership requests between users.

/mail/{mailId}.description: Emails to be sent by the Trigger Email extension.

/fellowships/{fellowshipId}.description: Stores details for each fellowship group.

/fellowships/{fellowshipId}/members/{use.description: Stores members of a specific fellowship.

/users/{userId}/fellowships/{fellowshipI.description: A subcollection to track which fellowships a user has joined.
